about.title: Bringing Quality and Flavour to Every Kitchen
about.lead: {store} is an emerging enterprise specializing in the processing, trading, and distribution of high-quality kitchen essentials, natural sweeteners, and everyday food products. Headquartered in Kotdwara, Uttarakhand, India, the company focuses on delivering quality kitchen staples to domestic and commercial markets.
about.chips: Kotdwara, Uttarakhand, India | Kitchen Essentials & Food Products
about.caption: Kotdwara, Uttarakhand, India

company.title: Everyday Essentials, Thoughtfully Presented
company.first: {store} works across the processing, trading and distribution of kitchen essentials, natural sweeteners and everyday food products — the staples that go into cooking every day.
company.second: From its base in Kotdwara, Uttarakhand, the company serves both domestic and commercial markets. A selection of the range can be ordered in our online shop, with every pack size and price listed.

commitment.title: Quality Matters in Every Kitchen
commitment.lead: The ideas that guide how {store} chooses and presents its range.
commitment.values:
Thoughtfully Selected Products
A focused range of spices, salt, honey and other staples, chosen with everyday cooking in mind.

Everyday Kitchen Essentials
Ingredients meant for daily use — the staples families reach for at every meal.

Serving Domestic and Commercial Needs
Supplying household kitchens as well as commercial customers, from our base in Kotdwara.

company.rangeLead: Explore our diverse range of kitchen essentials and everyday food products.
company.range:
Spices: Whole and powdered spices, including red chilli, turmeric, bay leaves, ginger and specialty blends.
Salt: Culinary salt varieties for everyday cooking and household use.
Hing (Asafoetida): Raw and compounded hing for traditional cooking.
Dry Fruits: Dry fruits and nuts for snacking and culinary use.
Oils: Edible cooking oils for everyday kitchen needs.
Honey: Natural honey products with their characteristic flavour and aroma.
company.closingBody: Discover the products that bring flavour and character to everyday cooking.

story.title: Bachpan Ke Pyaar Se Rasoi Ke Swad Tak
story.lead: {store} began with a childhood bond between two brothers and a shared vision of bringing flavour and care into everyday kitchens.
story.caption: Manu + Yogi

beginning.title: The Roots: Jab Sapne Ne Li Aakar
beginning.body: In 2018, {store} began as more than a business idea. It grew from the childhood dream and mutual trust of two brothers, Mayank Sati and Yogesh Sati, who founded the brand together.

meaning.title: Two Brothers. One Name. A Shared Dream.
meaning.lead: The name is deeply personal. It joins the childhood nicknames the two brothers grew up calling each other.
meaning.manuWords: Mayank’s affectionate childhood nickname, Manu, gives the name its “Man”.
meaning.yogiWords: Yogesh’s affectionate childhood nickname, Yogi, gives the name its “Yog”.
meaning.name: Manyog
meaning.nameWords: A name that carries childhood memories, brotherhood, trust, affection and unity.

family.eyebrow: From Our Family to Your Kitchen
family.title: Purity We Promise: Khet Se Rasoi Tak
family.lead: The values of care, trust, and togetherness that shaped the brand’s beginnings continue to inspire its journey. Today, the brand offers a growing range of kitchen essentials designed for everyday cooking.

values.title: What We Stand For
values.list:
Family and Togetherness
The name reflects the childhood bond between its founders and the values of trust and unity.

Care for Everyday Kitchens
The brand focuses on kitchen essentials and everyday food products for domestic and commercial customers.

Pure as Gold
An expression of the brand’s commitment to honesty, care, and the values behind its name.

story.closingTitle: From Childhood Memories to the Flavour of Your Kitchen
story.closingBody: {store} is more than a name. It represents the bond between Manu and Yogi, the trust that brought their dream to life, and the desire to share flavour with families through everyday kitchen essentials.

vision.title: Our Purpose: Vision & Mission
vision.tagline: Our Vision. Our Mission. Our Promise.
vision.lead: Rooted in family values and inspired by trust, {store} strives to bring quality food essentials closer to every home.
vision.caption: Pure as Gold

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.hindi: “Bharat ke har ghar mein shuddhata, imandaari aur bharose ka doosra naam banna, jahan har parivaar Manyog ko apne hi parivaar ka hissa maane.”
vision.english: To become a trusted name for purity, honesty, and confidence in every Indian home, so that every family considers us a part of its own family.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.lead: Our mission begins with the bond between the two brothers who founded the brand, Mayank and Yogesh Sati, and the values they grew up with.
mission.hindi: “Bhaiyon ke aapas ke vishwas aur bachpan ke sanskaaron ko aadhar banakar, grahakon (customers) tak 100% pure, natural aur premium quality ke food products kifayati daamon mein uplabdh karwana.”
mission.english: To build on the trust between the two brothers and the values instilled in them during childhood, making pure, natural, and premium-quality food products accessible to customers at affordable prices.

values.title: The Values Behind the Name
values.list:
Trust
Inspired by the bond between the founders and the trust at the heart of the name.

Honesty
A commitment to conducting business with honesty and care.

Quality and Accessibility
A focus on offering premium-quality food products at affordable prices, as expressed in our mission.

vision.closingBody: From the values that shaped our beginnings to the kitchens we aspire to serve, our purpose remains rooted in trust, quality, and togetherness.
